description: Call prep PDFs pushed to reMarkable had incorrect filenames. The files were misnamed — correct naming convention for call prep PDFs on reMarkable is not defined in the chase-call-prep skill. David moved the misnamed files to /Meetings manually.
correction: Call prep PDF filenames on reMarkable should follow the pattern: 'YYYY-MM-DD - [Company/Person Name].pdf'. This must be defined explicitly in the chase-call-prep skill and passed to Knox at upload time.
systemic_fix: chase-call-prep SKILL.md must specify the exact filename format for reMarkable uploads. Knox must use the filename provided by Chase, not derive one independently.
